paragraphs: This is This Week in Congress, from Power to the People, for the week ending Saturday, October 17th, 2026.
This briefing is read by a computer voice. Every fact in it comes from public records at Congress.gov, the House Clerk and Senate.gov.
The Senate held no recorded votes this week.
The House held no recorded votes this week.
Three bills became law: the Crow Tribe Water Rights Settlement Amendments Act of 2025, the Retire through Ownership Act, and the Illegal Red Snapper and Tuna Enforcement Act.
Coming up, the Senate next meets Monday, October 19th, 2026. The plan: convene for a pro forma session at 9:00 a.m. The House has not posted a floor schedule.
That's this week in Congress. You can read every bill and every vote in the app. Thanks for listening.
voice: Norman (Piper text to speech, public domain)
